requirement.evidence: an owner of residential real property shall not, over the course of any 12-month period, increase the gross rental rate for a dwelling or a unit more than 5 percent plus the percentage change in the cost of living, or 10 percent, whichever is lower, of the lowest gross rental rate charged for that dwelling or unit at any time during the 12 months prior to the effective date of the increase.
requirement.note: Two-increment limit, discount exclusion, and treble damages for willful violations are also stated in (a)(2), (a)(1), and (k)(1)(D).

key_value.evidence: increase the gross rental rate for a dwelling or a unit more than 5 percent plus the percentage change in the cost of living, or 10 percent, whichever is lower

effective_date.evidence: (n) This section shall become operative on April 1, 2024.
effective_date.note: Operative date matches the card; the history note gives a January 1, 2024 effective date, which the card's extractor notes mention.

status.evidence: (o) This section shall remain in effect until January 1, 2030, and as of that date is repealed.
status.note: As of 2026-10-01 the section is operative and not yet repealed.

coverage.evidence: (4) Housing that has been issued a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years, unless the housing is a mobilehome.
coverage.note: The 15-year certificate-of-occupancy exemption is supported. The owner_based_exemption_max_units of 2 is not stated as such: (d)(6) covers a property with two dwelling units in a single structure where the owner occupies one, and (d)(5) covers separately alienable property with owner-type conditions. Neither sets a maximum of 2 units for an owner-based exemption.
